title: Life Time Earns Spot on Fortune's 100 Fastest-Growing Companies List for 2026

body_markdown:
CHANHASSEN, Minn.


, Oct. 22, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Life Time Group Holdings, Inc. ("Life Time" or the "Company") (NYSE: LTH) today announced that it has been named to the[2026 Fortune 100 Fastest-Growing Companies list](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4804769-1&h=66426520&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffortune.com%2Franking%2F100-fastest-growing-companies%2F%3Fpage%3D4&a=2026+Fortune+100+Fastest-Growing+Companies+list) . This marks the Company's second consecutive year on the list.


The annual *Fortune* list, now in its 41st year, ranks publicly traded companies based on growth in revenue, profits, and stock returns, measured over the three years, a ranking built on performance rather than nominations.


"This recognition reflects what happens when our team members bring real passion to our athletic country clubs every day, whether that's a pickleball match, a Pilates class, our Signature Group Training classes or a Dynamic Personal Training session," said Life Time Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Erik Weaver. "Members come to us for the breadth of what they can do under one roof, and our healthy living ecosystem keeps them coming back. With a strong pipeline of new athletic country clubs and continued expansion of our products, services and digital offerings, we're well positioned for sustained growth as we help more people live healthy, happy lives."

**About Life Time**


Life Time (NYSE: LTH) empowers people to live healthy, happy lives through its more than 195 athletic country clubs across the U.S. and Canada, the complimentary and comprehensive Life Time app featuring its L•AI•C™ AI-powered health companion, and 30 iconic athletic events. Serving people ages 90 days to 90+ years, the Life Time ecosystem uniquely delivers healthy living, healthy aging, and healthy entertainment experiences, a range of unique healthy way of life programs, highly trusted LTH nutritional supplements and more. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, the company is committed to upholding an exceptional culture for its nearly 50,000 team members.
